en.q: An oncoming vehicle continues to display its turn signal and approaches the intersection without slowing down. What should you do?
options: Slow down first and proceed only after confirming it is safe.
Honk or flash your lights to remind the vehicle to let you pass first.
Vehicles going straight have priority; assume the other vehicle will yield to me.

zh-Hant.q: 對向的車輛持續顯示方向燈並未減速接近路口，你應該？
options: 先減速，並確認安全後再行駛。
按鳴喇叭或變換燈光，提醒該車輛讓你先通過。
直行車優先，預判對方會讓我先行。

en.q: When passing through an unsignalized intersection, you notice a motorcycle approaching from the side without slowing down. What should you do?
options: Speed up to pass and avoid conflict with the other vehicle.
Vehicles going straight have priority; assume the other party will yield to me.
Slow down and prepare to stop.

zh-Hant.q: 行經無號誌路口時，發現橫向有機車接近且未減速，你應該？
options: 加速通過避免與對方衝突。
直行車優先，應預判對方會讓我先行。
減速並預作停車之準備。

en.q: You notice a vehicle approaching from behind and displaying its turn signal in your rearview mirror. What should you do?
options: Speed up and drive away to avoid conflict with the other vehicle.
Release the accelerator and slow down to respond.
The other vehicle may not affect me, so there is no need to pay attention.

zh-Hant.q: 從照後鏡中發現有車輛接近並顯示方向燈，你應該？
options: 加速駛離避免與對方衝突。
放開油門減速因應。
對方不一定會影響我，不必理會。

en.q: When starting on a green light, you notice a vehicle from the cross direction showing no sign of slowing down and rapidly approaching the intersection. What should you do?
options: Delay starting and brake to a stop; proceed only after confirming the cross-traffic vehicle has stopped or passed.
Assume the other vehicle will stop at the intersection, and start at normal speed.
Since the light is green for me, start immediately and honk to remind the other vehicle to stop.

zh-Hant.q: 綠燈起步時，發現橫向的車輛似乎沒有減速跡象，並快速逼近路口，你應該？
options: 暫緩起步並煞停，確認該橫向車輛停下或通過後再行駛。
預判對方會於路口煞停，維持正常速度起步即可。
因為我是綠燈，應立即起步並按喇叭提醒對方停車。

en.q: Please identify the blind spot in the video from which a vehicle may emerge.
options: The pillar on the sidewalk.
Behind the oncoming vehicle.
Parked vehicles on the roadside.

zh-Hant.q: 請選出影片中的視線遮蔽處，可能會有車輛駛出？
options: 人行道上的柱子。
對向車輛的後方。
路旁的停車。

en.q: When turning right, there are pedestrians crossing on the pedestrian crosswalk at the intersection. What should you do?
options: Slow down and stop temporarily to let the pedestrians pass first.
Maintain speed and pass before the pedestrians enter your driving path.
Honk to remind the pedestrians that your vehicle goes first.

zh-Hant.q: 右轉時，路口的行人穿越道上有行人通行，你應該？
options: 減速暫停讓行人先行。
保持速度，並在行人進入本車行駛路線前通過。
按鳴喇叭，提醒行人本車先行。

en.q: A pedestrian on the roadside may cross the road. What should you do?
options: Honk or flash your lights to warn the pedestrian.
Maintain speed and swerve around them directly.
Slow down in advance and let the pedestrian cross first.

zh-Hant.q: 路邊有行人可能會穿越道路，你應該？
options: 按鳴喇叭或變換燈光以警示行人。
保持速度，直接閃避。
預先減速，讓行人先通行。

en.q: While driving on a freeway, the vehicle ahead to your right changes lanes to the left. What should you do?
options: First judge whether the safe distance is sufficient and slow down in advance.
No need to pay attention; the other driver will judge the safe distance from your vehicle on their own.
Honk or continuously flash your lights to remind the other driver that you go first.

zh-Hant.q: 行駛在高速公路上，右前方的車輛向左變換車道，你應該？
options: 先判斷安全距離是否足夠，並預先減速。
不須理會，對方會自行判斷與本車的安全距離。
按鳴喇叭或連續變換燈光，提醒對方你要先行。

en.q: When preparing to pull away from the roadside, what should you do?
options: Use the rearview mirror to confirm there are no vehicles approaching from behind.
Activate the turn signal.
All of the above.

zh-Hant.q: 準備在路邊起駛時，你應該？
options: 利用照後鏡確認後方沒有來車。
顯示方向燈。
以上皆是。

en.q: When preparing to make a left turn from the roadside, what should you do?
options: Activate the turn signal.
Confirm there are no pedestrians on the pedestrian crosswalk.
All of the above.

zh-Hant.q: 準備在路邊左轉彎時，你應該？
options: 顯示方向燈
確認行人穿越道線上沒有行人
以上皆是。
